data.name: Corrupt Knight
data.detailed_description:
A LEGACY FROM THE FIRST AGE, AN OUTCAST HERO Humanity was blessed with unique abilities bestowed by cosmic entities known as the "Tens" in the 1st Age. For millennia, every human born came into the world with their own special power as part of this divine legacy. Except for one: Timur.

Believed to be born without an ability, Timur was outcast and humiliated by society his entire life. Through years of isolation, his mind slowly drifted into deep gloom. However, there was a shocking truth no one knew: the true source of the massive Corruption that began to engulf the world, birthing anomalies and hideous creatures, was Timur's own darkened mind. He possessed a potential powerful enough to shape the world, yet equally dangerous.

To find the source of the corruption surrounding them, the people decided to send the most worthless among them to his death. Assigned to this suicide mission by his general, Timur sets out to fight the nightmares created by his own mind.

DEATH IS NOT AN END, BUT A CYCLE Timur is not alone on this suicide mission. One of his comrades in the army possesses the rare ability to resurrect the dead. As long as this ally holds an item belonging to him, Timur is brought back to life every time he falls on the battlefield, thrust back into the ruthless cycle of war.

KEY FEATURES

  • Deep and Flexible Skill System (Roguelite Progression) You can equip a maximum of 10 skills (5 active, 5 passive) while alive. Every 5 levels, you must choose one of 3 random skill options to create your combat style for that run. Whether you rotate fireballs, summon spirits for aid, and weave massive magic walls; or maximize your health, speed, and physical strike power with passive abilities. When you die, your skills and level are reset, giving you the chance to create a brand new build in every new life.

  • Permanent Loot and Powerful Equipment Defeat massive bosses deep within dark dungeons and loot valuable chests. Though death takes away your skills, the Swords, Armors, Masks, Gloves, Boots, Necklaces, and Shields you earn are permanent. Start one step ahead in every respawn with the extra armor, health, and damage stats provided by your equipment.

  • The Power of Talismans Rare Talismans are your greatest trump card in this cycle. When you equip a talisman, instead of starting from scratch after death, you respawn at the level determined by the talisman. This allows you to bend the rules of the game and accelerate your progression.

  • Explore a Ruthless World A confined open world full of dangers, with no merchants or safe havens. Save your progress by finding randomly spawning Monoliths on the map. Enter deadly dungeons, destroy the Boss at the end, claim your loot chest, and use the victory Monolith to save your game and exit. Piece together the shattered story of the corrupted world and the Tens by finding scattered mysterious statues and relics.

Are you ready to fight the corruption you created and plunge your sword into the heart of darkness?

data.short_description: Corrupt Knight is a game that combines a deep story with hardcore gameplay, where you can acquire up to 10 abilities, loot equipment from enemies, lose your abilities upon respawning to rebuild them, but retain your earned equipment, allowing you to return stronger every time.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
